summary: Renders a URL, local file, or DAT-provided webpage through Chromium Embedded Framework browser processes and returns the page image to TouchDesigner.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Enable or disable the browser render process

key_params.name: source
key_params.note: URL/file or DAT source

key_params.name: url
key_params.note: URL or file path when source is URL/file

key_params.name: dat
key_params.note: HTML/text source DAT when source is DAT

key_params.name: reloadsrc
key_params.note: Reload source DAT, URL, or file

key_params.name: reload
key_params.note: Reload the current page

key_params.name: resetcount
key_params.note: Reset the Info CHOP update counter

key_params.name: updatewhenloaded
key_params.note: Only show the webpage after it is fully loaded

key_params.name: alwayscook
key_params.note: Cook every frame instead of briefly after received updates

key_params.name: transparent
key_params.note: Use transparent page background; restarts browser process

key_params.name: audio
key_params.note: Disable, route to system audio, or route to Audio Web Render CHOP

key_params.name: mediastream
key_params.note: Allow microphone and camera access inside the browser process

key_params.name: redirectpopups
key_params.note: Redirect popups into the rendered URL instead of ignoring them

key_params.name: maxrenderrate
key_params.note: Maximum browser render frame rate

key_params.name: numbuffers
key_params.note: Maximum cached frame buffers

key_params.name: dpiscale
key_params.note: DPI scaling factor for the webpage

key_params.name: sharedtexture
key_params.note: Use Windows Direct3D shared texture instead of shared memory

key_params.name: userdir
key_params.note: Unique CEF cache/user-data directory

key_params.name: headerdat
key_params.note: Request-header override table

key_params.name: allowurls
key_params.note: URL allow-list table

key_params.name: blockurls
key_params.note: URL block-list table

key_params.name: options
key_params.note: Additional Chromium options; restarts browser process

key_params.name: autorestart
key_params.note: Automatically restart the browser process if it dies

key_params.name: autorestartpulse
key_params.note: Manually restart the browser process

common_gotchas: Each Web Render TOP needs a unique user cache directory in current builds.
Transparent background, audio routing, and options changes restart the browser process.
Shared Texture is Windows-only and can fail unless TouchDesignerWebRender.exe uses the same GPU as TouchDesigner.
Use Info DAT/CHOP to inspect loaded status, process status, URL/title/error, and update counts.
Rendered targets can be internet URLs, local file:// pages, or DAT-provided pages, but Flash content is not supported.
key_concepts: Web Render TOP renders a URL, local file, or DAT-provided page through separate CEF browser processes.
Rendered frames return to TouchDesigner through shared memory or, on Windows, a Direct3D shared texture.
Info CHOP and Info DAT expose load state, browser process status, versions, current URL/title, errors, and update counts.
Multiple TouchDesigner Web Render processes may be spawned for a single Web Render TOP.
